d:
Besan se parhez hai? Bina besan ka super soft, spongy Khaman Sooji, dahi aur sweet corn se, bas 15 min steam!
Poonam Devnani ki is Masala Kitchen recipe mein seekhiye Bina Besan Ka Khaman, sooji, dahi aur sweet corn se, soft aur jaalidar.
Sooji ka lump-free batter, dahi aur pani ke saath
Sweet corn, mirch, adrak ka natural paste, swaad double
Eno kab daalna hai, beginners ke liye pakki trick
Bina paani ke tadke ke bhi soft khaman, upar butter ka tadka
Comment karein: khaman ke saath kaunsi chutney? Hari, meethi ya ketchup?
